line: By default, n8n never tells you when a workflow dies.
A node fails, the execution turns red in your history — and that's it. No email, no Slack message, nothing.
Most people never open that history unless something already feels wrong. By then, it could've been broken for weeks.
The fix is one setting: an Error Workflow, wired to an Error Trigger node.
Set it once, in Settings, and every workflow that fails from then on tells you immediately — Slack, email, whatever you want.
It's not a hidden feature. n8n even ships their own template for it. Almost nobody turns it on.
The exact setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
